headline: The Artist Cao Fei Weighs How We Can Preserve Our Humanity in the Age of A.I.
context: In a major show at the Kunstmuseum Basel, Gegenwart, the artist considers technology, humanity and how people can preserve “our human life” in the age of A.I.
